title: Declare acceptance telemetry signals as artifact-based telemetry URNs

facts.note: Acceptance artifacts are identifiable by file kind / path.
Any creation or revision of an acceptance, regardless of which section changes.
Planner task produces or revises acceptances.

fires: Planner writes a new acceptance (with or without a signal section yet).
Planner revises any part of an existing acceptance, including then/when-only edits.
Planner revises an acceptance that is missing required telemetry signals.
Planner adds or changes a metric, trace, log or event signal on an acceptance.
doesNotFire: Editing a wagon, plan or doc artifact that is not an acceptance.
Code-level implementation of telemetry emission (coder concern, not acceptance authoring).
Reading or reviewing acceptances without creating or revising one.

given: An acceptance is being created or revised
when: The planner writes the acceptance and its telemetry signals
then: Every acceptance declares telemetry signals (REQUIRED) named as artifact-based URNs: metric telemetry:metric:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}]:{measure}; trace telemetry:trace:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}] (no measure); log optional telemetry:log:...; event telemetry:event:... or Title Case analytics name.
prefer: Planes: ui, ux, be, db, nw, st, tm, sc, au, fn, if.
avoid: Metrics not derived from 'then' quantifiable expectations, or events not derived from 'when' user actions (both MUST).
Operations/wagons in the URN: they MUST go in attributes.
A resource that is not a past-tense verb from the lexicon (MUST).
A measure on a trace; a measure mismatched to artifact kind; a plane/measure outside the lists.
why: Artifact-based URNs give every acceptance verifiable, uniformly named telemetry; operations/wagons in attributes keep URNs stable and low-cardinality.
evidence: Each acceptance has at least one declared telemetry signal.

Each metric URN matches telemetry:metric:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}]:{measure} with plane and measure from the allowed lists; each trace URN matches telemetry:trace:{plane}:{artifact}[.{category}] with no measure.
Every metric traces back to a quantifiable 'then' expectation and every event to a 'when' user action.
No URN segment names an operation or wagon; operations/wagons appear as signal attributes.
The resource segment is a past-tense verb from the lexicon.
verifier_detail: measure = the trailing measure segment of a metric URN; allowed: latency, duration, throughput, error_rate, success_rate, count, size, age, staleness, freshness.
plane = the leading plane segment; allowed: ui, ux, be, db, nw, st, tm, sc, au, fn, if.
Entity artifacts (nouns) use measures: count, size, age, staleness, freshness. Event artifacts (past-tense verbs) use: latency, duration, throughput, error_rate, success_rate.
Resource must be a past-tense verb from the lexicon.
log signals are optional: telemetry:log:...; event may be telemetry:event:... or a Title Case analytics name.
Source examples: metric telemetry:metric:be:order:created:duration (histogram, p95, 200ms); trace telemetry:trace:be:order:created (server); event telemetry:event:be:order:created / 'Order Created'.
